response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count FROM district AS d LEFT JOIN client AS c ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), totals AS (SELECT district_id, region, client_count, SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_count, SUM(client_count) OVER () AS overall_count FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(region_count, 0) AS fraction_of_region, 1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(overall_count, 0) AS fraction_of_overall FROM totals ORDER BY fraction_of_overall DESC, district_id LIMIT 10;
